component.name: MC7 Studio
component.summary: Configure the Turtle Beach Command Series MC7 mouse

description.p: MC7 Studio is an independent desktop configurator for the Turtle Beach Command Series MC7 mouse on Linux, macOS and Windows.
It manages onboard profiles, sensitivity, buttons, macros, lighting, the LCD, host integrations, settings backups and official firmware updates.
Fixes custom surface calibration, application-icon refresh and 8 kHz wireless configuration.
Adds Linux 2.4 GHz wireless configuration, receiver lighting and power support, and clearer device status.
